result.citation: Berkeley Mun. Code § 13.76.130(A) (as amended by Measure BB, Nov. 5, 2024, Ord. 7950-NS); see also id. § 13.76.130(A)(1)
result.citation_basis: § 13.76.130(A) and (A)(1): O096 (codified text), also O050; Ord. 7950-NS: O096 history note (Ord. 7950-NS § 2, 2024), also O050 (Ordinance No. 7,950-N.S.); Measure BB and Nov. 5, 2024: O052 (election results declaring Measure BB passed at the Nov. 5, 2024 election), also O050
result.official_quote: No landlord shall be entitled to recover possession of a rental unit covered by the terms of this Chapter unless said landlord shows the existence of one of the following grounds: This subsection shall not constitute grounds where the amount of rent demanded is less than one month of fair market rent for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
result.note: The citation follows the lawyer's form: her section § 13.76.130 and her Measure BB, Nov. 5, 2024 parenthetical are confirmed by O096, O050 and O052; it is narrowed to subsection (A), which holds the just-cause rule, with the nonpayment threshold added as a see-also cite to (A)(1), and Ord. 7950-NS is added from the O096 history note; the card's quoted_span remains from D006, a Rent Board web page in the supplied corpus that is not the law's text, so the official quote is taken from the codified section in O096.
